name: Thane of Falkreath
plugin: Skyrim.esm (last edited by LoreRim - Dialogue Patch.esp)
canDoWhy: It starts quietly the first time you enter Falkreath; once you have done enough for the hold, you go back to the Jarl to be named Thane.

needs.what: Help the people of Falkreath (the journal counts this as "Assist the people of Falkreath", 3 needed)

starts.how: The quest switches on when you arrive in Falkreath. When the hold's needs are met, the journal tells you to return to the Jarl.

firstStep: Return to the Jarl of Falkreath in Hakkvild's High Hall

takesYou.why: the Jarl names you Thane here

objectives: Return to the Jarl of Falkreath

rewards.what: A hold weapon from the Jarl (the quest holds a jarl's-weapon slot)
Gold and a piece of armor are set up in the quest's script

people.name: Siddgeir
people.role: Jarl of Falkreath, placed in Hakkvild's High Hall

people.name: Dengeir of Stuhn
people.role: the other possible Jarl (he sides with the Stormcloaks); placed in Dengeir's House in Falkreath

people.name: Rayya
people.role: your housecarl, placed in Hakkvild's High Hall

unsure.why: The 3-helper count comes from the companion journal quest that tracks favors for every hold; the Jarl's own dialogue conditions aren't in these extracts, so other requirements may apply.
The Hearthfire add-on edits this quest and supplies the housecarl; the records don't show whether you must also own the Lakeview land near Falkreath.
The quest's script holds a reward armor list, a large gold list and gold, but nothing shows when or whether each is handed over.
A thane-weapons add-on in the list adds a jarl's-weapon slot; its weapons include a Hunter Axe of Falkreath (one- and two-handed), but the records don't show which one fills the slot.
Siddgeir's only listed schedule is a shared civil-war package, so he is given by where he is placed.
Which of the two men is Jarl depends on who holds Falkreath; both carry this quest's giver faction (Siddgeir Imperial, Dengeir Stormcloak).

needs.what: Earn the Jarl of Riften's favor (the journal later tells you to speak to the Jarl)

starts.who: Laila Law-Giver (or Maven Black-Briar if she rules Riften)
starts.how: When the journal says to speak to the Jarl of Riften, talk to the Jarl; she tells you to buy a house in the city.

firstStep: Speak to the Jarl of Riften in Mistveil Keep

takesYou.why: talk to the Jarl and buy Honeyside from the steward

objectives: Speak to the Jarl of Riften
Return to the Jarl of Riften

rewards.what: The title Thane of the Rift
A hold weapon from the Jarl (the quest holds a jarl's-weapon slot)

people.name: Laila Law-Giver
people.role: Jarl of Riften, placed in Mistveil Keep

people.name: Maven Black-Briar
people.role: Jarl of Riften if the Empire puts her in charge; placed in Black-Briar Manor

people.name: Anuriel
people.role: Laila's steward, sells Honeyside; placed in Mistveil Keep

people.name: Hemming Black-Briar
people.role: steward under Maven; placed in Black-Briar Manor

unsure.why: What sets the journal to 'speak to the Jarl' isn't in these extracts. The companion favor tracker counts 'Assist the people of The Rift' (5 for a major hold), and the Jarl also appears in the Riften skooma quests, but no condition ties either to this quest here.
No housecarl is part of this quest's records, and Honeyside's price isn't given.
A thane-weapons add-on (and a LoreRim weapons patch) adds a jarl's-weapon slot; its weapons include a Black Blade of the Rift, but the records don't show which weapon fills the slot.

Laila, Anuriel and Hemming have only shared or general schedules here, so they're given by where they're placed; Maven has her own schedule (market, Bee and Barb, keep visits) and may be elsewhere in Riften by day.
